title: Tillman's first band, the Peerless Band, with his brother
summary: His brother Edward and the family made up a little band, later named the Peerless Band, with brother-in-law Gaudet as leader and manager.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Well, my brother played. Oh, yeah? Yeah, that's my brother, Edward Tillman.
Let's get your name on here so we can, your name is? Edward. Mm-hmm. And what did you play?

I played trombone, trumpet, and drums. Oh, you got it right quite a bit, huh? Oh, yeah. Did you all play together much? Yeah, he played with me when I first started playing. Mm-hmm. Yeah, we made up a little band among ourself, you know? Mm-hmm.
